function.name: user_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a user based on the provided user name and the status of the mandates. This API is intended for use by partners to retrieve information about their clients' mandates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The full name of the partner's client for whom to fetch mandates.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched. If omitted, mandates of all statuses will be retrieved.

function.name: partner_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a partner based on the specified status. If no status is provided, all mandates are retrieved. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched. If left empty, mandates with any status will be retrieved.

message.content:
A **mandate** is a formal authorization or directive that gives someone the power or right to act on behalf of another party. It can take various forms depending on context:

| Context | What it means | Typical example |
|---------|---------------|-----------------|
| **Legal / Corporate** | A written or verbal instruction from a principal (e.g., a company’s board) to an agent (e.g., a director or officer) to perform specific actions. | A board resolution authorizing a CEO to sign contracts up to a certain value. |
| **Financial / Banking** | An agreement that allows a bank or payment service to execute transactions on a customer’s behalf—often used for recurring payments. | A standing order that automatically transfers €500 monthly from a checking account to a savings account. |
| **Government / Politics** | A formal assignment of authority from a higher body to a lower one, often seen in parliamentary systems where a government receives a “mandate” from voters. | A political party winning a majority in elections, giving it a mandate to implement its platform. |
| **Project Management** | A documented scope of work that defines what a team or individual is responsible for delivering. | A project charter outlining deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities. |

In short, a mandate is a clear, authorized instruction that empowers the recipient to act within defined limits.
